name: Douglas Matzke
abstract_title: Existons solve the hard problem of consciousness at the Planck Scale
abstract: The "hard problem" of consciousness continues to be unresolved as long as we assume its emergence from brain processes. More recent consciousness conference discussions have suggested we move away from reductionism and toward quantum-informational models to understand Consciousness. After all, quantum-informational models have revolutionized everything in our society perhaps, except medicine/psychology.
